$comment: Scenarios this skill must pass. Shape follows Anthropic's published eval format (skills, query, expected_behavior). Run each in a fresh session against an empty project, once per model tier, and score every expected_behavior line pass or fail. A failure is a skill edit, not a retry.

evals.query: Add Rendobar to this project so I can compress user uploads to about 5 MB.
expected_behavior: Reads the live job catalog from GET https://api.rendobar.com/jobs/types instead of naming job types from memory
Reads the per-type schema for the compression job before constructing params
Installs @rendobar/sdk for a JavaScript or TypeScript project, or uses plain REST for any other stack
Asks for RENDOBAR_API_KEY to be placed in a gitignored env file and never requests the key in the chat
Catches ApiError and branches on err.code rather than on the error message text
Does not invent a batch endpoint or add a /v1 prefix to the API base

evals.query: My Rendobar job came back complete but the video looks wrong. What now?
expected_behavior: States that a complete status proves the job ran, not that the output is correct
Probes the output with an ffprobe job rather than trusting the status
Checks concrete properties such as duration, stream counts, dimensions, and non-zero size
Suggests extracting and viewing a frame for a visual result instead of assuming

evals.query: My call failed with WaitTimeoutError. Resubmit it?
expected_behavior: Says no, a timeout is not a failure and the job may still be queued
Calls jobs.get(id) to read the real status before any resubmission
Warns that resubmitting without an idempotencyKey double bills
Recommends passing an idempotencyKey on any submit that can be retried

evals.query: Give me a quick smoke test that Rendobar is wired up correctly.
expected_behavior: Chooses ffprobe as the cheapest proof of auth and wiring
Uses the public sample asset at https://cdn.rendobar.com/assets/examples/sample.mp4
Does not propose a long or high resolution source for a smoke test
Optionally runs scripts/preflight.mjs, and does not read that script's source into context

evals.query: The Rendobar output URL I saved yesterday stopped working. Is my file gone?
expected_behavior: Says the file is probably fine and distinguishes the two expiries rather than conflating them
Explains that output.expiresAt is the signed URL's life, about an hour, not the file's
Points at retentionExpiresAt on the job as the actual deletion time, and notes it is plan driven
Tells the user to re-fetch the job for a fresh URL rather than caching one
Recommends copying anything that must outlive the retention window into their own storage

evals.query: A Rendobar job came back failed. Should I retry it?
expected_behavior: Reads error.retryable on the job instead of inventing a retry policy
Treats the job error as a structured object with code, message, detail, and failedPhase, not as a string
Checks error.detail for the underlying provider output when present
Notes that a failed job is a 200 response with status failed, not a request error, and that jobs.wait throws JobFailedError for it

evals.query: I got a 401 from Rendobar and my env file definitely has the key in it.
expected_behavior: Names both causes: the key may not be reaching the process, or the key itself may be invalid for this API
Mentions a wrong-environment key, such as a staging key used against production, as a specific case
Verifies which cause applies rather than guessing, for example by calling the API directly with the same key
Never prints or echoes the key value while debugging

evals.query: Turn this photo of my dog figurine into something I can 3D print on my Bambu A1. https://example.com/dog.jpg
expected_behavior: Uses 3d.generate with the photo as inputs.front and printer bambu-a1
Asks for the real size in mm, or states the default it will use, instead of inventing one
Checks the request with validate_3d or POST /3d/validate before submitting
Shows the user the resolved size, printer and formats and waits for a yes before submitting
Shows reference.png as a preview without claiming the model is printable from it
Says the sliced .gcode.3mf opens in the printer's slicer and that print time and filament are estimates

evals.query: Make me a 3D model of a little robot.
expected_behavior: Asks whether it is for printing or for an app before choosing a printer or formats
Writes a prompt that names one object with its shape, material and style, and no lighting, camera or background
Offers image.generate first so the user can approve the look, or enhancePrompt for a short prompt
Validates and gets a yes before submitting 3d.generate

evals.query: I have a 400 mm tall statue STL and an Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra. Make it printable.
expected_behavior: Uses 3d.prepare with the STL as inputs.mesh, not 3d.generate
Explains the model is taller than the plate and that split cuts it into pinned parts, or that a smaller sizeMm fits in one piece
Offers hollow for a resin print of this size
Validates before submitting and reads any exceeds_plate problem by its code

evals.query: Generate a replacement shelf bracket I can print. The screw holes are 40 mm apart and it has to hold books.
expected_behavior: Says a generated mesh is not dimensionally accurate enough for a part that must fit screws and carry load
Recommends CAD or a text-to-CAD tool instead of submitting 3d.generate
Does not submit a paid job before the user agrees to a decorative-only result
